reason.description: in-use: something still refers to the record; duplicate: the record, or a value that must be unique such as a name, exists already; managed: a dependent with its own account, a staff link or dependents of its own, which its guardians may not edit; has-account: the person has an account already; room-taken: another lesson uses the room at that time (see lesson), the request may be repeated with confirmRoomOverlap; past: the lesson would start in the past, the request may be repeated with confirmPast; generated: a lesson of a class is canceled, not deleted; already-booked: the person has an active booking for the lesson; full: the active bookings and the places reserved for the waiting list fill the lesson's capacity, or the members fill the class's capacity; closed: the lesson cannot be booked (see why); already-canceled: the booking, or the receipt, is canceled already; not-full: the lesson has a free place, so it is booked rather than waited for; already-waiting: the person is on the lesson's waiting list already; not-invited: the waiting-list entry has no invite to accept or decline; invite-expired: the invite ran out, was declined, or the lesson started; invite-used: the invite was accepted, or its entry left the list; not-waiting: the entry is no longer on the waiting list; already-voided: the pass is voided already; receipt-settings-incomplete: receipts cannot be issued, so passes not sold, until an admin completes the receipt settings (the detail names what is missing); pass-used: the pass of the receipt paid for visits, so its sale cannot be canceled (void the pass instead); cancellation: the receipt is a cancellation, which cannot be canceled; timezone-locked: lessons exist, so the school's time zone cannot change; currency-locked: prices or receipts exist, so the currency cannot change; mail-limit: the school day has as many emailed announcements as allowed (sent and scheduled); expired: the announcement has expired, so it is no longer edited (it can be deleted); not-failed: only a failed mail is queued again; secret-link: a mail with a secret link (a confirmation, password reset, invite or waiting-list invite) is not queued again, the flow that sends a new link is used instead; two-accounts: both persons of a merge have an account, so one is disabled first; guardian-cycle: after the merge a guardian of the survivor would also be its dependent; anonymized: the person is anonymized already; sole-guardian: the person is the only guardian of a dependent, so another guardian is linked or the link removed first; last-admin: the account is the last admin who can sign in (enabled and confirmed), which is not disabled, demoted or deleted; own-account: an admin does not disable, demote or delete their own account (another admin does).

position.description: Place among the waiting entries, 1 for the next to be invited; absent unless waiting.

status.description: waiting: for an invite; invited: a place is reserved until expiresAt; expired: the invite has run out (the entry is about to end, or to go back to the end of the list).

stayOnList.description: Whether an invite that expires or is declined puts the entry back at the end of the list.

closed.description: Why the lesson cannot be booked now, if it cannot (see the closed conflict); the place cannot be taken then.

expiresAt.description: Until when the invite reserves (or reserved) the place; absent while waiting.

givenName.description: Given name of the person the place is reserved for.

position.description: Place among the waiting entries, 1 for the next to be invited; only with state waiting.

state.description: invited: the place is reserved until expiresAt and can be taken (unless closed says otherwise); accepted: it was taken; expired: the invite ran out, was declined, or the lesson started, and the entry ended; withdrawn: the person left the list, or got booked otherwise; waiting: the invite ended, but the person is back on the list (see position) and gets a new link with the next invite.

info.description: Schedule and booking API for dance and ballet schools.
info.title: Studio Schedule API

get.description: Returns every account with its person, ordered by email.

delete.description: Deletes an account with its password, sessions, links, calendar feeds and announcement dismissals; its person stays. Records that only name it as who did something (booking events, lesson cancellations, pass sales, …) forget it. An account that receipts, the audit log, announcements or duplicate dismissals name is a 409 `in-use`: disable it instead. Recorded in the audit log. Refused: the admin's own account (409 `own-account`) and the last admin who can sign in (409 `last-admin`).

post.description: Disables an account: it may no longer sign in, and its sessions and the impersonations it started end. A disabled account stays disabled. Recorded in the audit log. Refused: the admin's own account (409 `own-account`) and the last admin who can sign in (409 `last-admin`).
Enables a disabled account again. Recorded in the audit log. The admin's own account is a 409 `own-account`.

Signs the admin in as another account ("login as") for at most one hour and sets the session cookie; the admin's own session ends. Recorded in the audit log. Admins cannot be impersonated (403); a disabled or unconfirmed account is a 409.

put.description: Gives an account another role; it takes effect with the account's next request. Recorded in the audit log. Refused: the admin's own account (409 `own-account`) and the last admin who can sign in (409 `last-admin`).
put.summary: Change the role of an account

get.description: Returns every announcement, scheduled and expired ones included, newest publication first.

post.description: Publishes an announcement at `publishAt` (default: now) until `expiresAt` (optional). The title is one line of 1 to 120 characters, the text plain text of 1 to 4000 (line breaks normalized to `\n`, trimmed, no control characters but line breaks and tabs, no invisible format characters but the zero-width joiners; a 422 on the field otherwise). With `email`, it is mailed once to its audience, each address once, in its account's language: at once if it publishes now, else at `publishAt`. Guests without an account are not reached. A school day has at most 3 emailed announcements, sent and scheduled together; beyond that a 409 `mail-limit`. An unknown class, course type or lesson is a 422 on its field.
Returns how many addresses an announcement for the audience would be mailed to now, for the confirmation before emailing. An unknown class, course type or lesson is a 422 on its field.

delete.description: Deletes an announcement with its dismissals. If it was emailed, it still counts for that day's limit.

put.description: Replaces an announcement's fields, like `createAnnouncement`, until it expires; an expired one is a 409 `expired`. An edit never mails again: one emailed already stays emailed, whatever `email` says; one not emailed yet is emailed like a new one.

get.description: Returns the latest 200 audit events, newest first, with the accounts they name.
Returns every change of the booking, oldest first, with the account that made it (the admin when an admin was signed in as someone else; none for the system).
Returns the persons enrolled in a class, ordered by family and given name.
get.summary: List the members of a class

get.description: Returns pairs of persons that may be the same, at most 200: strong ones (the same email, a person's or its account's, ignoring case; or the same name and birth date) first, then weak ones (the same name, a birth date unknown). Names compare ignoring case, accents and hyphens, with umlauts spelled out. A guardian and its dependent, or two dependents of one guardian, do not match by the email alone. Dismissed pairs and merged persons are left out.

post.description: Records that two persons are not the same, so the pair is no longer listed. Dismissing a pair again changes nothing; an unknown person is a 404.

get.description: Returns the latest 50 applied imports, newest first, with who ran them, their counts and the rows they could not take.

post.description: Imports the members of a CSV file with a mapping of its columns. Each row is a member found by its member number, and up to two guardians found by their email (an account's or a person's, ignoring case) or else by their name; what is not found is created. An update writes only the mapped fields the row fills; guardian links are added, never removed; no accounts are created. Rows with problems are left out and reported. Without `apply` it is a dry run that writes nothing; with it, the import is recorded in the run history. A mapping that does not fit the file is a 422 on `body.mapping`, an unreadable file one on `body.content`.

Reads a CSV file (UTF-8 or Windows-1252; separated by semicolons, commas or tabs; at most 1024 KiB and 5000 rows) and returns its headers, its first rows and a mapping of the headers it recognizes by their English or German names. A file it cannot read is a 422 on `body.content`. Nothing is stored.

Copies the scheduled lessons of a school day, or of a week from Monday to Sunday, to another day or week in one transaction. Each copy is a one-off lesson at the same school-local wall-clock time, with the course type, room, staff, length, capacity, kind and visibility of its source and no bookings. Canceled lessons are not copied. A source lesson is skipped with a reason: `class-slot` when its class has a slot in the target week within its term (generation makes that lesson), `started` when the copy would not start in the future, `staff-inactive` when its instructor or accompanist is no longer active, and `room-taken` when another lesson that is not canceled, a lesson of a class that generation has not created yet, or an earlier copy of the same clone uses the room at an overlapping time, checked in this order. Nothing is changed or deleted, and nobody is mailed. A week's dates must be Mondays (422 on `body.source` or `body.target`); a target equal to the source or before today (a week: its Monday) is a 422 on `body.target`.
post.summary: Clone a day or a week

post.description: Returns what `cloneLessons` would create and skip now, without changing anything.
post.summary: Preview a clone of a day or a week

post.description: Returns the mails of the outbox, newest first, 50 at most per page, without their bodies; `nextCursor` asks for the next page. Filters by status, template and a part of the recipient (ignoring ASCII case). The bodies of mails sent more than 30 days ago are removed, and mails older than 180 days deleted. A POST, so that the addresses searched for stay out of URLs and the access logs of proxies (ASVS 8.3.1); it changes nothing.

get.description: Returns a mail of the log with its text and HTML, except for the templates that send a secret link (confirm-email, change-email, reset-password, invite, waitlist-invite), whose bodies never leave the server, and for bodies the purge removed (see `body`).

post.description: Queues a failed mail again: its next attempt is now and its attempts start over. A pending or sent mail is a 409 `not-failed`; a mail with a secret link is a 409 `secret-link` (the flows that send a new link do that). Recorded in the audit log.

get.description: Returns every pass type ordered by name, retired ones included.

post.description: Adds a pass type. A name another pass type has (ignoring case) is a 409 `duplicate`.

delete.description: Deletes a pass type that was never sold; a sold one is a 409 `in-use` and is retired instead.

put.description: Replaces the fields of a pass type; `active: false` retires it, so it is no longer sold. Passes sold already keep their visits, days and price. A name another pass type has is a 409 `duplicate`.

post.description: Stops the sale of a pass type (`active: false`) and changes nothing else; retiring a retired type changes nothing. Passes sold keep what they were sold with. An unknown type is a 404.
Voids a pass: it pays for nothing more, and what it paid for stays paid. A voided pass is a 409 `already-voided`.
Adds a person without an account, e.g. a second parent or a staff member's record.

Merges a duplicate person into the survivor: its bookings, waiting-list entries, class memberships, passes (owned and paid for), guardian links, staff links and account move to the survivor. Where both have a booking of the same lesson that has not started, the duplicate's is canceled (a visit it cost comes back); of a lesson that has started, both stay as history. Where both are members of a class, the survivor's membership stays, and the duplicate's automatic bookings of the class follow it. The survivor takes the fields `take` names from the duplicate and keeps both notes, or the `notes` given (at most 2000 characters, else a 422); the duplicate stays as a hidden record for its receipts, which are listed under the survivor. Without `apply` it only tells what would happen. Both with an account is a 409 `two-accounts` (disable one first: a disabled account of the duplicate stays with it); a merge after which a guardian would also be a dependent of the survivor a 409 `guardian-cycle`. Recorded in the audit log.

Returns the persons whose given name, family name, email or member number contains every word of `query`, ignoring case, ordered by family and given name; at most 50; merged persons are left out. For the office's pickers, e.g. linking a staff member to a person. A POST, so that the search terms stay out of URLs and the access logs of proxies (ASVS 8.3.1); it changes nothing.

delete.description: Deletes a person, e.g. one created by mistake. While anything refers to it (an account, a staff link, bookings, class memberships, passes they own or paid for, or a guardian link in either direction) that is a 409 `in-use` and nothing changes.

get.description: Returns every field of a person with its guardians, dependents, account, linked staff members and class memberships.

put.description: Replaces every field of a person, including the email and the office's notes. The email of the person's account, its login name, stays as it is.

post.description: Creates an unconfirmed account without a password for an existing person and mails it an invitation, whose link (valid for 72 hours) sets the password and confirms the account. A person with an account is a 409 `has-account`, an email another account has a 409 `duplicate`. Only an admin may create an admin account; for the office that is a 403.
post.summary: Create an account for a person

post.description: Erases a person's personal data: the name becomes "Deleted person", and email, phone, birth date, notes and member number are cleared. Guardian links in both directions, class memberships, open waiting-list entries and staff links are removed, bookings of lessons that have not started are canceled on time (a visit they cost comes back), and the account is deleted with its sessions, links and calendar feeds. Past bookings, passes and receipts stay. Recorded in the audit log. Refused: an unknown or merged person (404), an anonymized one (409 `anonymized`), the only guardian of a dependent (409 `sole-guardian`), a person whose account receipts, the audit log, announcements or duplicate dismissals name (409 `in-use`), the caller's own person (409 `own-account`), the person of an admin account unless an admin asks (403), and that of the last admin who can sign in (409 `last-admin`).

get.description: Returns everything the school stores about a person as one document (GDPR): the person, its family links (names only), account, bookings, waiting-list entries, passes with their redemptions, receipts (no PDFs), calendar feeds, dismissed announcements and class memberships. No secrets: no password hash, no session, link or feed token. A merged or anonymized person is exported too.

post.description: Links a guardian to the person, e.g. a second parent. A guardian linked already is a 409 `duplicate`; an unknown guardian, the person itself, or one of its dependents (directly or through others, which would make the links a cycle) is a 422 on `guardianId`.

delete.description: Ends a guardianship. The person stays, even without a guardian left; a guardian who is not linked is a 404.

get.description: Returns the passes of a person with what they paid for: the usable ones first, then the others, each newest sale first. An unknown person is a 404.

post.description: Gives the person a pass of an active type without payment, with an optional note why. It fails like `sellPass`.

parameters.description: The person who gets the pass.
parameters.name: personId

schema.description: The person who gets the pass.

post.description: Sells a pass of an active type to the person: it copies the type's visits and days from `validFrom` (default: today in the school's time zone) and records the price paid (default: the type's price) and who paid (`payerId`, default: the person). An unknown person is a 404; an unknown or retired type a 422 on `body.passTypeId`, an unknown payer on `body.payerId`. A new pass pays for nothing booked before. The sale issues its receipt (ADR 0012): numbered, with the payment method and the recipient, rendered as a PDF and mailed to the payer's account (else to `recipientEmail`, else nowhere). Incomplete receipt settings are a 409 `receipt-settings-incomplete`: every sale has a receipt.

parameters.description: The person who gets the pass.
parameters.name: personId

schema.description: The person who gets the pass.

post.description: Returns the receipts that match the filter, newest first (by number), and how many match in all. A POST, so that the names searched for stay out of URLs and the access logs of proxies (ASVS 8.3.1); it changes nothing.

get.description: Returns a receipt with its lines, the cancellation that canceled it or the receipt it cancels, and whether it can be canceled. An unknown receipt is a 404.

post.description: Issues the cancellation receipt (Storno) of a sale: the next number, every line negated, the same payer, recipient and payment method, mailed to the payer like the receipt. It voids the pass the receipt confirms. A pass that paid for visits is a 409 `pass-used` (void the pass instead); a receipt canceled before a 409 `already-canceled`, a cancellation a 409 `cancellation`, incomplete receipt settings a 409 `receipt-settings-incomplete`. An unknown receipt is a 404.

get.description: Returns the PDF of a receipt as it was issued (an attachment named after its number). An unknown receipt is a 404.
Returns the weekly release rule, the cutoffs, the hold of waiting-list invites and the members' early access, with the release window now.

put.description: Replaces the booking rules from now on. A wider window (more weeks ahead, more days of early access, a later released-through date) generates the lessons it reaches at once (`generatedLessons`). Invalid fields are a 422 on them.

get.description: Returns the release window that a release rule would have now, without changing anything.

parameters.description: The day of the weekly release, 0 = Sunday to 6 = Saturday.
parameters.name: releaseWeekday

schema.description: The day of the weekly release, 0 = Sunday to 6 = Saturday.

parameters.description: The time of the release (HH:MM) in the school time zone.

schema.description: The time of the release (HH:MM) in the school time zone.

parameters.description: How many weeks each release opens.

get.description: Returns the accent color, its dark-mode variant, the theme and whether a logo and a background exist.

put.description: Sets the accent color, or the app's own without one. It must reach a WCAG contrast of 4.5:1 against the text on it and the page; else a 422 on `body.accentColor`. The dark mode shows a variant derived from it. A `theme` changes the school's theme; without one it stays. The logo is the receipts' logo (updateReceiptLogo), the background is updateBrandingBackground's.

delete.description: Removes the school's background image; themes that show one fall back to their own.

put.description: Sets the school's background image, which themes that show one put behind the app: a JPEG, PNG or WebP image of at most 1 MiB, base64 encoded. Another type is a 422 on `body.contentType`; an empty or larger image, or data that does not match the type, one on `body.data`.

get.description: Returns when bookings use a pass.

put.description: Sets when bookings use a pass from now on. Bookings redeemed before stay as they are; a booking follows the new mode the next time it changes.

get.description: Returns the issuer, the tax mode and the texts printed on receipts, and whether they are complete: passes are sold only when they are.

put.description: Replaces the receipt settings and the number prefix. Receipts issued before keep what they were issued with. Invalid fields are a 422 on them; incomplete settings are allowed, but block sales.

delete.description: Removes the logo; later receipts have none.

get.description: Returns the logo printed on receipts; a 404 without one.

put.description: Sets the logo printed on receipts from now on: a PNG or JPEG of at most 512 KiB, base64 encoded. A larger image, or data that does not match the type, is a 422 on `body.data`.

get.description: Returns the time zone, the default language and the currency, and which of them are fixed by the data.

put.description: Replaces the time zone, the default language and the currency. The language may always change. A new time zone once lessons exist is a 409 `timezone-locked`, a new currency once a price or a receipt exists a 409 `currency-locked`: they are chosen at the first setup. Invalid fields are a 422 on them.

get.description: Returns the school's name and legal notice.

put.description: Replaces the school's name (shown in the header, the page title and mails) and its legal notice (shown in the footer). Invalid fields are a 422 on them.

get.description: Returns every staff member ordered by display name, including former (inactive) staff and the link to a person, which the public `listStaff` leaves out.

Returns the school's figures of a range of school dates, in the school time zone: bookings, attendance, late cancellations, trials and guests, waiting lists and utilization by week (by month beyond 26 weeks) and by class, room, course type and instructor, the active members, and the pass sales from the receipts, cancellations netted, and the top 20 participants by active bookings (merged and anonymized persons left out); no other person is named. Canceled lessons count only as such. The presets end today; a custom range has at most 366 days (else a 422). The term range without a term that includes today is a 404.

parameters.description: The range: the current week and the 3 or 11 before it, the current term up to today, or from–to.
parameters.name: range

schema.description: The range: the current week and the 3 or 11 before it, the current term up to today, or from–to.

parameters.description: First school date of a custom range.
parameters.name: from

schema.description: First school date of a custom range.

parameters.description: Last school date (inclusive) of a custom range.
parameters.name: to

schema.description: Last school date (inclusive) of a custom range.

get.description: Returns the weekly classes of a term like `listClasses`, including retired classes, which the public list leaves out.
get.summary: List all classes of a term

get.description: Returns the announcements shown now (published, not expired) that reach the signed-in account, newest first, each with whether the account dismissed it. One reaches an account if it is for everyone, for the account's role, or for persons among which are the account's person or one of its dependents: the members of a class, or of the classes of a course type whose term has not ended, and those booked for one of their lessons that is not over; or those booked for a lesson.

post.description: Hides an announcement from the account's banner; it stays in its list. Dismissing it again changes nothing. While an admin is signed in as the account, nothing is stored. One that is not shown or does not reach the account is a 404.
Confirms the email address with the token from the confirmation link and the account's password, and signs in. An unknown, used or expired link is a 410.

Checks the password (a wrong one is a 422 on body.password) and mails a confirmation link to the new address; the account keeps its address until the link is used. The answer is the same if the new address already has an account (then no mail is sent). Refused (403) while an admin is signed in as the account.
Moves the account to the new address with the token from the link and mails a notice to the old address. An unknown, used or expired link is a 410; an address taken in the meantime is a 409.
Ends an impersonation and signs the admin in again with a new session cookie. A 409 if the session is no impersonation.

put.description: Sets the language of the mails the account receives; without a locale the school's default applies.

post.description: Signs in with email and password and sets the session cookie. A wrong email or password is a 401; a correct password for an unconfirmed email is a 403. Too many attempts per client or wrong passwords per email are a 429 with Retry-After.
Ends the session and clears the session cookie.

get.description: Returns the signed-in account, or 401 without a valid session. While an admin is signed in as the account, impersonator names the admin.

post.description: Replaces the password after checking the current one (a wrong one is a 422 on body.currentPassword), ends every other session of the account and mails the account that its password was changed. Refused (403) while an admin is signed in as the account.
Mails a link to set a new password to the address if it belongs to an account that may sign in. The answer is the same for every address. Too many mail requests per client are a 429 with Retry-After.

Sets the password with the token from the reset link and ends every session of the account; it does not sign in. If the account had a password, it gets a mail that its password was changed. An unknown, used or expired link is a 410.
post.summary: Set a new password with a reset link

post.description: Creates a member account and mails a confirmation link to the email address. The answer is the same whether the address is new or already registered. Too many mail requests per client are a 429 with Retry-After.

Sets an active booking to `attended`, `no_show` or back to `booked` (unknown). From the lesson's start on (before it a 422 on `path.bookingId` with reason `not-started`), until the end of its school day for instructors and accompanists (afterwards a 422 on `path.bookingId` with reason `day-over`), at any time after the start for the office. Each change adds a booking event. A canceled booking is a 409 `already-canceled`, a lesson the school canceled a 409 `closed` with why `canceled`.

Cancels a booking of the signed-in person or one of their dependents (404 for any other booking) and frees its place. A booking canceled already is a 409 `already-canceled`; one whose lesson has started a 422 on `path.bookingId`. From the cancellation cutoff before the start on, the cancellation is allowed but `late`, unless the school canceled the lesson. The signed-in account gets a mail.

get.description: Returns what `cancelFollowing` would cancel now with `until`, without changing anything, and fails like it (an `until` before the lesson's date is a 422 on `query.until`). Without `until`, the response names the default: the last day of the class's term.

parameters.description: Last slot date to cancel; default: the last day of the class's term.
parameters.name: until

schema.description: Last slot date to cancel; default: the last day of the class's term.

post.description: Cancels a booking of a class lesson together with the same person's other active bookings of that class from this lesson on up to the slot date `until` (default: the last day of the class's term) whose lessons have not started, in one transaction, each `late` like in `cancelBooking`. A person who is a member of the class stays one but is paused until then: they are booked automatically again only into the lessons after it (`pausedUntil`). A booking of a one-off lesson, or one whose lesson has started, is a 422 on `path.bookingId`; an `until` before the lesson's date a 422 on `body.until`; a canceled booking a 409 `already-canceled`; any other person's a 404. The signed-in account gets one mail listing every canceled booking.

put.description: Sets whether an active booking is a trial, and its note for the instructor (a note without `trial` is a 422 on `body.trialNote`). Same access and time window as `addLessonParticipant` (a 422 on `path.bookingId` with reason `day-over` once the day is over for instructors); a canceled booking is a 409 `already-canceled`.

post.description: Cancels a booking of the lesson as staff: never late, and a person's date is released, so a later change of their class membership does not book them into it again. Its place goes to the waiting list. After the start too (a walk-in added by mistake), until the end of the lesson's school day for instructors and accompanists (afterwards a 422 on `path.bookingId` with reason `day-over`), at any time for the office, and on a lesson the school canceled. Before the start of a lesson that takes place, the participant's mail recipients get the cancellation; for a canceled lesson nobody is mailed or invited. A canceled booking is a 409 `already-canceled`; a booking of a lesson of others a 404.

delete.description: Deletes a class with its lessons while none of them has started or been booked (automatic bookings of former members aside) and it has no members; otherwise it is a 409 `in-use` and can be retired instead.

put.description: Replaces the fields of a class; its term stays. The future lessons that were not edited one by one follow, with their bookings; a capacity below the class's member count or the bookings of one of them is a 422 on `capacity`. A retired class generates no more lessons and leaves the public timetable; its future lessons that still follow it and have no bookings but the automatic ones of class members are deleted with those.

post.description: Enrolls a person in a class and books them into the class's lessons from `since` on that have not started, canceled ones included, even beyond a lesson's capacity, unless they have a booking for the lesson already (one canceled when an earlier membership ended aside). An unknown person is a 422 on `personId`, a person who is a member already a 409 `duplicate`, a retired class a 422 on `path.classId`, and a class whose members fill its capacity a 409 `full`.

delete.description: Ends a person's membership in a class and cancels their bookings of the class's lessons that have not started, without a mail; a person who is not a member is a 404.

put.description: Replaces the dates of a membership: `since` and the end of a pause, `pausedUntil` (left out: not paused, which ends a pause). Then books the member into the class's lessons that have not started and that they are active on but have no booking for, as `addClassMember` does (a date they released stays released), after canceling their automatic bookings of those they are no longer active on (a new pause, a later `since`), without a mail. A person who is not a member is a 404, a retired class a 422 on `path.classId`.

get.description: Returns all course types (dance styles) ordered by name.

post.description: Adds a course type. A name another course type has (ignoring case) is a 409 `duplicate`.

delete.description: Deletes a course type that no class or lesson uses; a used one is a 409 `in-use`.

put.description: Replaces the name and description of a course type; its classes and lessons show the new name. A name another course type has is a 409 `duplicate`.

get.description: Lists fictional demo accounts, one per role, with their password. Only in a demo installation; otherwise a 404.
Lists the newest mails of the outbox, so that the demo, which delivers no mail, can show them (e.g. the confirmation link). Only in a demo installation; otherwise a 404.
Returns the file a mail of the demo mailbox attaches (a receipt's PDF). A mail without one is a 404. Only in a demo installation; otherwise a 404.

Returns the signed-in person and their dependents (usually children without their own login), each with its other guardians. A managed dependent, one with its own account or a staff link, is read-only here.

post.description: Creates a person (a child without their own login) with the signed-in person as guardian.

delete.description: Ends the signed-in person's guardianship. A dependent left without a guardian is deleted, unless it is managed (it stays); while it has bookings or class memberships, that is a 409 `in-use` and nothing changes. Anyone else's person is a 404.

put.description: Replaces the name, phone and birth date of one of the signed-in person's dependents. A managed dependent is a 409 `managed`; anyone else's person is a 404.
Replaces the signed-in person's name, phone and birth date.

get.description: Reports that the service is running. It names no version (ASVS 14.3.3): the office finds it in getMe.

post.description: Adds a lesson without a class, e.g. a workshop or a private lesson, which are published early; a regular one follows the release window. An unknown course type, room or staff member is a 422 on the field that names it. A start that is not in the future is a 409 `past` unless `confirmPast` is set. Another lesson in the room at an overlapping time is a 409 `room-taken` naming it, unless `confirmRoomOverlap` is set.

delete.description: Deletes a one-off lesson that has not started (422 on `path.lessonId` otherwise) and that no booking refers to (409 `in-use` otherwise). A lesson of a class is canceled instead (409 `generated`): generation would create it again.

get.description: Returns one lesson the caller may see (see getSchedule), with its free places and, for a signed-in caller, whom of their family it has booked. Lessons that do not exist or are not visible are reported alike as not found. Office and admin accounts also get `admin`: the detached flag, the active bookings and the cancellation details.

put.description: Replaces the time, room, staff, capacity, visibility and kind of a lesson that has not started (422 on `path.lessonId` otherwise); course type and class stay. A lesson of a class is detached from it: class and term edits leave it alone from then on. A capacity below the active bookings is a 422 on `capacity`. A new start in the past is a 409 `past` unless `confirmPast` is set. A new time or room is checked like in `createLesson` (409 `room-taken`). A new start or room of a scheduled lesson mails everyone with an active booking, unless it now starts in the past.

post.description: Sets every booking of the lesson whose attendance is unknown (`booked`) to `attended`, under the rules of `setAttendance` (the 422s on `path.lessonId` with reason `not-started` or `day-over`), and returns the bookings it changed.

Books the lesson for the signed-in person or one of their dependents (managed ones included). A person outside the family, or a lesson the caller may not see, is a 404. Everyone books under member rules: staff get a 409 `closed` with why `release` for a lesson members may not book yet (not released, beyond their early access) or at all (hidden). A canceled lesson is a 409 `closed` with why `canceled`, one that has started a 409 `closed` with why `started`, and one whose booking cutoff has passed a 409 `closed` with why `cutoff`, checked in this order. A person booked already is a 409 `already-booked`, a lesson whose active bookings fill its capacity a 409 `full`. The signed-in account gets a confirmation mail.

Cancels a lesson that has not started (422 on `path.lessonId` otherwise), with an optional note, and mails everyone with an active booking. The bookings stay. A canceled lesson stays as it is, note included, started or not.

Mails the plain-text `message` (line breaks normalized to `\n`, trimmed, 1 to 1000 characters, no control characters but line breaks and tabs, no invisible format characters but the zero-width joiners; a 422 on `body.message` otherwise) to everyone booked for the lesson: the mail recipients of every active booking and the guests with an email, each address once, each in its language. The mail names the sender as the schedule does if they teach or accompany the lesson, else by their name, and replies go to the sender's address (the admin's while signed in as someone else). Same access as `listLessonParticipants` (a 404 on others' lessons); lessons that are over or canceled too. An account sends at most 5 notices an hour, and a lesson gets at most 3 a school day, from anyone: beyond that a 429 with `Retry-After`. Returns how many addresses were mailed; a lesson without any counts no notice.

get.description: Returns every booking of the lesson, canceled ones included, with the participant's name and contact data, and its waiting list, ended entries included, with the counts. The office sees every lesson, an instructor or accompanist the lessons they teach or accompany (their staff record linked to their person); any other lesson is a 404.

post.description: Books a person (`personId`) or a guest (`guest`, a name and an optional email) into the lesson as staff (source `staff`), optionally as a `trial` with a `trialNote`. Unlike `bookLesson`, the release window and the booking cutoff do not apply, and the lesson may have started: instructors and accompanists add until the end of the lesson's school day (afterwards a 422 on `path.lessonId` with reason `day-over`), the office at any time. A lesson the school canceled is a 409 `closed` with why `canceled`. A person booked already is a 409 `already-booked`; a lesson whose active bookings and the places held by others' waiting-list invites fill its capacity a 409 `full`, unless `confirmOverCapacity` is set (the booking event records the override). A person whose own invite holds a place takes it without the confirmation (an override if the lesson has been overbooked since); any other entry of the person on the lesson's waiting list ends. Before the lesson starts, the person's mail recipients, or a guest with an email (in the school's language, asked to contact the school to cancel), get the confirmation. Lessons of others are a 404, an unknown person a 422 on `body.personId`.

Lets a canceled lesson that has not started take place after all (422 on `path.lessonId` otherwise) and mails everyone with an active booking its current time and room. Another lesson in the room at an overlapping time is a 409 `room-taken` naming it, unless `confirmRoomOverlap` is set; the body is optional. The lesson stays detached from its class. A scheduled lesson stays as it is, started or not.

Puts the signed-in person or one of their dependents at the end of the waiting list of a full lesson. Whenever a place frees, the oldest waiting entry is invited by mail; the invite reserves the place until `expiresAt`. With `stayOnList`, an invite the person lets expire or declines puts them back at the end of the list instead of ending the entry. A person outside the family, or a lesson the caller may not see, is a 404; a lesson that cannot be booked a 409 `closed` with `why`, as in `bookLesson`. A person booked already is a 409 `already-booked`, one on the list already a 409 `already-waiting`, and a lesson with a free place (`freePlaces` > 0) a 409 `not-full`: book it instead.
